title: Sally's first train ride
titleZh: 萨莉第一次乘火车旅行
evenTitle: Someone invited Sally to a party. / Sally was invited to a party.
evenTitleZh: 有人邀请萨莉出席一个聚会。／萨莉应邀出席一个聚会。

lines.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
lines.zh: 上周，我4岁的女儿萨莉被邀请去参加一个儿童聚会。

lines.en: I decided to take her by train.
Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
lines.zh: 萨莉非常激动，因为她从未乘过火车。

lines.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
lines.zh: 她靠车窗坐着，对她所看到的一切都要问个明白。

lines.en: Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
lines.zh: 突然，一个中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉的对面。

lines.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
lines.zh: 萨莉没回答，却好奇地看着她。

lines.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
lines.zh: 那位妇女穿着一件蓝色的大衣，戴着一顶大而滑稽的帽子。

lines.en: After the train had left the station,
the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
lines.zh: 那位妇女打开了手提包，拿出了粉盒。

lines.en: She then began to make up her face.
'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
lines.zh: “你为什么要那样做呢？”萨莉问。

lines.en: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
lines.zh: “为了把自己打扮漂亮啊，”那位妇女答道。

lines.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
lines.zh: 她放好了粉盒，慈祥地微笑着。

lines.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
